title: Apollo's Deal Spree Drives Fee-Related Revenue to a Record
title_zh: Apollo 的交易热潮推动收费相关收入创历史新高
summary: Bloomberg's Laura Benitez joins Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals." Apollo Global Management reported record revenue from fees as it vies to be one of Wall Street's largest lenders.
summary_zh: 彭博社的劳拉·贝尼特斯 (Laura Benitez) 与丹尼·伯格 (Dani Burger) 一起参加“彭博交易”。阿波罗全球管理公司公布了创纪录的收费收入，该公司力争成为华尔街最大的贷方之一。

title: Nvidia Just Won a Major SpaceX AI Deal. Stock Jumps as AMD Sinks
title_zh: Nvidia 刚刚赢得了 SpaceX 的一项重大人工智能交易。 AMD 股价下跌，股价上涨
summary: Nvidia Stock Rises as SpaceX Picks It Over AMD for AI Infrastructure
summary_zh: 随着 SpaceX 在人工智能基础设施领域选择英伟达而非 AMD，英伟达股价上涨

title: Blackstone pitches $36 billion debt deal for Anthropic AI chips
title_zh: Blackstone 拟定 360 亿美元债务交易收购 Anthropic AI 芯片
summary: One early proposal put the package at $36 billion, which would exceed the $35 billion deal closed roughly two months ago
summary_zh: 一项早期提案将一揽子计划定为 360 亿美元，这将超过大约两个月前完成的 350 亿美元交易

title: Salesforce (CRM) Lands VA Deal as Its Undervalued Narrative Gets Fresh Support
title_zh: Salesforce (CRM) 获得 VA 交易，其被低估的说法得到新的支持
summary: Salesforce (CRM) has secured a three year Agentic Enterprise License Agreement with the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs, a contract valued at up to US$1.6b that highlights growing demand for its AI driven government cloud services. See our latest analysis for Salesforce.
summary_zh: Salesforce (CRM) 已与美国退伍军人事务部签订了为期三年的代理企业许可协议，该合同价值高达 1.6 亿美元，凸显了对其人工智能驱动的政府云服务日益增长的需求。请参阅我们对 Salesforce 的最新分析。

title: Top Midday Stories: Bessent Says US, Iran Could Soon Reach Hormuz Deal; Palantir Shares Soar on Strong Q2 Results, Guidance
title_zh: 午间热门故事：贝森特称美国和伊朗可能很快达成霍尔木兹协议； Palantir 股价因第二季度强劲业绩和指引而飙升
summary: All three major US stock indexes were up in late-morning trading Tuesday, as investors grew more opt
summary_zh: 周二早盘交易中，美国三大股指均上涨，投资者的选择增多
